toolsPreview.name: list_datasets
toolsPreview.description: List all available elevation datasets on the Geospatial System server.

toolsPreview.name: LP_Get_Elevation
toolsPreview.description:
Get the elevation in metres at a specific lat/lon coordinate.
Available on all tiers including Free.

toolsPreview.name: LP_Get_Elevation_Batch
toolsPreview.description:
Get elevation for up to 100 points in one call.
Pass a list of objects: [{"lat":…,"lon":…,"dataset_id":…}, …]
Available on all tiers including Free.

toolsPreview.name: LP_Get_Elevation_Stats
toolsPreview.description:
Get elevation statistics (Min, Average, Max) for 3×3, 5×5 and 7×7 pixel
windows centred on the coordinates. Requires Pro or Enterprise key.

toolsPreview.name: LP_Get_Slope_Stats
toolsPreview.description:
Get terrain slope statistics (Min, Average, Max) in degrees for 3×3,
5×5 and 7×7 pixel windows. WGS-84 corrected. Requires Pro key.

toolsPreview.name: LP_Get_Elevation_Chart
toolsPreview.description:
Generate a range-box chart showing elevation Min/Avg/Max across three
neighbourhood window sizes. Returns a URL to the chart image.
Requires Pro key. Supports PNG / SVG / PDF.

toolsPreview.name: LP_Get_Slope_Chart
toolsPreview.description:
Generate a range-box chart showing terrain slope Min/Avg/Max across three
neighbourhood window sizes. Returns a URL to the chart image.
Requires Pro key. Supports PNG / SVG / PDF.

toolsPreview.name: LP_Get_Terrain_Map
toolsPreview.description:
Generate a composite terrain map: Google Hybrid satellite (EPSG:3857) +
smoothed contours with labels + flow-direction arrows + location pin.
All layers are reprojected to EPSG:3857 — no overlay mismatch.
Requires Pro key. Supports PNG.

toolsPreview.name: LP_Get_Terrain_3D
toolsPreview.description:
Generate a 3-D perspective terrain surface map (Plotly go.Surface)
coloured by elevation with a red spike pin marking the query location.
Requires Pro key. Supports PNG / HTML.
